retention.production: Retain latest public prediction, cumulative history and compact public reports.
retention.evidence: Retain immutable sealed manifests and compact adoption or rejection evidence.
retention.state: Retain only compact resumable state needed by active workflows.
retention.diagnostics: Retain latest compact summaries; upload reproducible detail to Actions artifacts.

rules: Canonical directories are the long-term public layout.
New implementations must read canonical paths first and use legacy paths only as fallback aliases.
Resume state is copied, never destructively moved, until every workflow uses canonical paths.
Immutable sealed evidence must never be pruned or rewritten by migration utilities.
Generation 5 candidate, fixed-Null and promotion summaries are diagnostics until promotion succeeds.
Large reproducible detail files are Actions artifacts rather than permanent repository history.
